name: Fish Audio
description: Generates speech, clones voices and transcribes audio through REST and WebSocket APIs backed by open-weight models, for developers building voice apps and phone agents.

skills.name: Text to Speech
skills.description: Converts text to speech with emotion tags and fine-grained pronunciation control, over REST or real-time WebSocket.

skills.name: Voice Cloning
skills.description: Creates reusable custom voice models from reference audio.

skills.name: Speech to Text
skills.description: Transcribes audio, including multi-speaker conversations with speaker turns.

skills.name: Voice Design
skills.description: Generates candidate voices from a natural-language prompt.

skills.name: Voice Agent Platform
skills.description: Builds voice agents with knowledge bases, webhook tools and phone numbers, deployable via web SDK or widget.
